## Before you write anything

Never paste real school data into this issue. That includes credentials,
session tokens, cookies, raw upstream responses, pupil or staff names, school
or tenant identifiers, and anything from a private-fixtures directory.

Describe the shape of what you saw instead of its contents: field names,
types, counts, status codes. If you cannot describe the problem without a real
value, say so and stop rather than pasting it.
